messages.subject: Difficulties with scale_datetime
parts:

I tried to generate a minimal example but it _works_ and so I am at a loss.  Here is the example:

start <- ISOdate(2001, 1, 1, tz = "")
df <- data.frame(day30  = start + round(runif(100, max = 30 * 86400)))
tmp<-strftime(df$day30)
y<-rnorm(100)
df<-data.frame(x= strptime(tmp, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), y=y)
qplot(x,y,data=df)+ scale_x_datetime(major="1 week")
